caseName: McQuillen v. National Cash Register Co.
caseNameFull: McQuillen v. National Cash Register Co.
attorneys: Mr. Israel Gorovitz for petitioners. Mr. James Piper for the National Cash Register Co., and Mr. William L. Marbury, Jr. for Ezra M. Kuhns et al., respondents.

opinions.text:
The motion to dispense with the printing of the record is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit is denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.
